sections.heading: Animal Cells
sections.content: Animal cells contain a nucleus, cytoplasm, cell membrane, mitochondria and ribosomes.

sections.heading: Plant Cells
sections.content: Plant cells have a cellulose cell wall and a permanent vacuole. Photosynthetic plant cells also contain chloroplasts.

sections.heading: What are Enzymes?
sections.content: Enzymes are biological catalysts. They speed up chemical reactions without being used up.

sections.heading: Temperature and Enzymes
sections.content: High temperatures can denature enzymes by changing the shape of their active sites.
